kind: resolvability gate measurement (declared in POM-aerial1940s-z16-jericho.declaration.json); written before any fit and before any zone view
method: 10-90 % rise width of the mean profile across a straight edge, sampled every 0.25 raw pixel over +-6 raw pixels, averaged along the edge, on the raw zoom-16 mosaic (no resizing). All edges lie outside the full-resolution mask (E 191725-192625, N 142070-142775).
edge_rule_added_here: Only profiles with a contrast of at least 30 grey levels are counted as edges; lower-contrast profiles are listed but did not cross a real edge. This rule was added after measuring; it cannot change the gate, because the nominal pixel alone fails it.

consequence: The zone is not opened at full resolution. It stays unseen in this layer. The 600-dpi Hebrew University scans of the RAF frames (PS30 5107, PS30 5137, PS32 5069-5070; record REC-RAF-JERICHO; about 0.6 m per pixel at 1:15,000, INFERENCE) are needed, and even they sit near the 0.5 m threshold.
other_observations_outside_zone: The mosaic joins several photographs with different contrast; a seam runs about 150 m west of the tell. The spring house and the 1898 reservoir are not identifiable. The Tawahin es-Sukkar complex is not identifiable as a walled ruin.
